senses.gloss: m. pl. (= איתמ׳, play on מִיטָּה and אמיטתא) those who go to bed with the setting in of darkness (a witty expression made up in oppos. to שיחרין, v. שְׁחַר).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 47">Ex. R. s. 47</cite> <he>למדו תורה דא׳</he> learn the teachings of those who rested well by night (as better fitted to teach).
